result.title: Wayfinder: Adaptive Resource Routing from Agent Citations
result.comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 10 tables. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026
result.summary: To act effectively, agents must gather contextual information across resources such as chats, issue trackers, email and knowledge bases, to answer questions like "what was decided in the last project meeting?" or "where is the FAQ for our internal tooling?" Where this information lives in a user's environment is unknown to the agent, so it re-explores the same resources across consecutive interactions. Common routing approaches represent each resource as a tool and rely on high-level descriptions to generalize to unseen environments. Such descriptions often fail to separate similar or overlapping resources and cannot improve from the agent's subsequent interactions. We introduce Wayfinder, an adaptive router that uses the documents cited by the downstream agent as feedback about where relevant information resides. These citations update Wayfinder's internal resource representations, which subsequent interactions use to prioritize the resources likely to contain relevant information. We also introduce resource augmentation during offline reinforcement learning, which anonymizes and permutes resource identities to discourage training-time overfitting of which resource holds which topic; our ablations suggest it helps most when few training environments are available. Because no openly available professional environments pair realistic queries with resource-access patterns, we construct and release three controlled testbeds derived from existing datasets: NFCorpus, FEVER and Tech Startup. Compared with supervised, tool-retrieval and contextual bandit baselines under a shared closed-loop protocol, Wayfinder gives the best routing when resources contain semantically overlapping content that static descriptions cannot distinguish, while description-based tool retrieval suffices when resources are drawn from distinct corpora.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Wayfinder，一种自适应资源路由器：它把下游 agent 实际引用的文档当作「相关信息在何处」的反馈，据此在线更新内部资源表示，使后续交互优先检索可能相关的资源；并结合离线强化学习中的资源匿名与置换增强，在 NFCorpus、FEVER、Tech Startup 三个受控测试床上与监督、工具检索和 contextual bandit 基线作闭环比较。
AI.relevance_reason: 「用下游引用作为弱监督来更新资源表示」这一机制可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与贡献分配提供可核查的训练线索，但该工作面向纯文本 agent 路由，能否迁移到 latent 状态与多模态证据仍需判断。
